body:
### Summary

uv 0.12.11 fails to install some packages with long tempfile paths on Windows when [`LongPathsEnabled=0`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/fileio/maximum-file-path-limitation?tabs=registry#registry-setting-to-enable-long-paths).

We generally try to set `LongPathsEnabled=1` everywhere in our environment, but there are some CI VM images that don't currently have it enabled. The `LongPathsEnabled` flag is read at each process startup, so it's easy to toggle before running uv. Changing `LongPathsEnabled` requires Admin permissions.

| uv version | `LongPathsEnabled=0` | `LongPathsEnabled=1` |
|----|----|----|
| 0.12.10 | ✅ | ✅ |
| 0.12.11 | ❌ | ✅ |

## MRE

This is with [`LongPathsEnabled=0`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/fileio/maximum-file-path-limitation?tabs=registry#registry-setting-to-enable-long-paths).
